description: This file contains unit tests for the Analytics component, including mock server setup, test cases for event sending, event mapping, and service activation/deactivation, primarily using Google Test and Google Mock frameworks.

classes.name: ServerMock
classes.description: A mock server class that sets up a TCP socket, listens for incoming connections, receives data, and responds with HTTP status codes.

classes.name: AnalyticsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for analytics-related tests, inheriting from L2TestMocks, setting up mocks and environment for testing analytics event sending and mapping.

methods.name: AnalyticsTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes mocks, sets up environment, and activates services for testing.

methods.name: ~AnalyticsTest
methods.description: Destructor that deactivates services, cleans up files, and restores environment after tests.
